matrix_meaning: Each stored R_l is the canonical Cayley Delta_l returned by bank.layer(l).matrix(), materialized on the training GPU and copied as contiguous FP32 CPU bytes. It is not the one-stage H@Delta product.
runtime_orientation: Canonical two-stage row-vector q/k.float()@H128@R_l; recurrent recovery applies R_l then H128 on the key axis. No transpose, precomposition, or alternate cumsum.
same_host_gate: Bitwise exact 24 stored matrix hashes and selected non-AIME operator/functional probe hashes between canonical theta bank and direct frozen bank; no post-hoc tolerance.
cross_host_gate: SHA256 identity of the transferred artifact bytes, followed by direct-load canonical runtime and QDQ/writeback checks. The original host must not recompute R on this deployment path.
